en.title: Green Bean Salad with Red Onion (Salatit Fasulya Khadra)
en.intro: Recipe 332, page 146 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: String the beans and trim the tops and tails.
steps.n2: Boil in salted water until tender, drain and spread out to cool.
steps.n3: Put the sliced onion in the salad bowl to soak in the lemon juice.
steps.n4: Before serving, add the beans and oil and mix.

legacySteps: String the beans and trim the tops and tails.
Boil in salted water until tender, drain and spread out to cool.
Put the sliced onion in the salad bowl to soak in the lemon juice.
Before serving, add the beans and oil and mix.
